[SWS_DM_01072] Persistency of defined DDIDs
⌈
If DiagnosticDynam-
icallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.configurationHandling is set to non-
Volatile, the DM shall persist DDIDs configured by the UDS service 0x2C and restore
the DDDID definition from Non-Volatile Memory at DM Initialization.
